rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT REPEALING ACT NO. 7160 ALSO KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991, SECTION 17 (B), PARAGRAPH 1(V), ON THE OBLIGATION OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS TO MAINTAIN BARANGAY ROADS, BRIDGES AND WATER SUPPLY SYSTEMS
rows.abstract: Seeks to revert the responsibility of maintaining barangay roads, bridges and water supply systems to the national government.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2008-11-18

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH THE PRESIDENTIAL DEBATE COMMISSION
rows.title_short: Presidential Debate Reform Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Establishes the Commission that will schedule the debates for presidential and vice presidential candidates and formulate the guidelines for the conduct of the debates.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2008-11-18

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE OFFICE OF RESEARCH ON WOMEN'S HEALTH
rows.title_short: Research On Women's Health Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Seeks to establish an office that shall be responsible for the conduct of reseach on women's health and collaborate with other entities conducting similar studies.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WOMEN AND GENDER EQUALITY since 2008-11-18

rows.author: F094

rows.title_short: Drug-free Borders Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Provides the Bureau of Customs, The Philippine Coast Guard and the Department of national Defense additional funds which shall be used exclusively for the purpose of halting the entry of illegal drugs into the country.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on DANGEROUS DRUGS since 2008-11-18

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REQUIRE INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION TO WIDELY DISTRIBUTE INFORMATION DESCRIBING THEIR PROCEDURES FOR RECEIVING AND RESPONDING TO COMPLAINTS CONCERNING HARASSMENT
rows.title_short: Sexual Harassment Awareness Reporting And Posting Act
rows.abstract: Requires colleges and universities to disseminate to their students the procedures in reporting sexual harassment complaints.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2008-11-18

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING GOVERNMENT AGENCIES AND NON-GOVERNMENT AGENCIES TO REGISTER ALL OFFENDERS CONVICTED OF ANY ACT INVOLVING CHILD ABUSE WITH THE DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE
rows.title_short: National Child Abuser Registration Act
rows.abstract: Provides for the establishment of a central repository of information on all child abusers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2008-11-18

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO IMPROVE THE QUALITY OF BEACHES AND COASTAL RECREATION WATER
rows.title_short: Beaches Environmental Assessment, Closure, And Health Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Seeks the adoption of certain criteria to ensure that the water quality in beaches is protected and improved.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2009-02-10

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR UNIFORM WARNINGS ON PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT FOR OCCUPATIONAL USE
rows.title_short: Uniform Warnings On Protective Equipment Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: To ensure the safety and health of workers in the workplace, the bill requires employers to train, educate and instruct their employees on the proper use of personal protective equipment.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2008-11-18

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH THERAPEUTIC EQUIVALENCE REQUIREMENTS FOR GENERIC DRUGS
rows.title_short: Generic Drug Uniformity Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Seeks to regulate the production of generic drugs to ensure that they contain the same active ingredients and have the therapeutic equivalent of those listed in the essential drugs list or the national drug formulary.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2008-11-18

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR TECHNICAL PREPARATION EDUCATION IN PUBLIC SECONDARY SCHOOLS AND STATE COLLEGES AND UNIVERSITIES
rows.title_short: Tech-prep Education Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Seeks to award grants to public high schools and state colleges and universities that develop and operate four-year technical preparation education programs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2008-11-18

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR FREE COMMUNICATION BY PROHIBITING CENSORSHIP IN ALL FORMS OF MEDIA THAT INTERFERES WITH THE RIGHTS OF FREE SPEECH, FREE PRESS, AND FREE EXPRESSION
rows.title_short: Free Communications Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Prohibits the promulgation of an regulation that may interfere with the rights of free speech, free press and free expression.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2008-11-18

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PREVENT LUXURIOUS CONDITIONS IN PRISONS
rows.title_short: No Frills Prison Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Seeks to prohibit any prisoner from enjoying a living condition within its prison that is more luxurious than those conditions extended to the average prisoner.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2008-11-18

rows.title_short: Women And Children's Resources Act Of 2008

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2008-11-18

rows.title_short: Safe Havens For Children Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Provides for the establishment of visitation centers where victims of domestic violence may meet/visit, under supervision, with the estranged parent/partner.

rows.abstract: \"The Race Horse Jockeys Retirement Act of 2008.\" Sets the compulsory retirement age for racehorse jockeys at 50 years old in order for them to have ample time and opportunities to practice other horse-racing professions such as horse trainers, or even train jockeys immediately after their retirement.

rows.abstract: Seeks to thwart instances where the bank wittingly and willingly misrepresented itself by adopting a business name contrary to its classification thus convincing and creating confusion and thereby jeopardizing the interest of the depositors and exposing them to great risks and providing stiffer penalties therefor.

for those registered voters who have physical or sensory limitations like the disabled and the 
elderly, as enshrined in Section 29 of Repaublic Act No. 7277,  the Magna Carta for the Disabled 
Persons.
